overall_summary: Family emotional bonds, universal relationships, and broad motivation (like talking to loved ones or parents) significantly outperform hyper-niche digital heartbreak micro-stories (such as deleting phone widgets or settings). Viewers engage best with pure emotional validation and familial love over repetitive smartphone-themed self-respect angles.

winning_patterns.action: Pivot the core focus more heavily towards universal family and interpersonal relationships while keeping the emotional tone.

weak_patterns.action: Abandon micro-digital settings tropes and focus on deeper human interactions.
